definitions.ask: Should apollo, the feed host, read its feed token from a mode-600 file instead of decrypting it with pass?
definitions.why: The token is already plain text in apollo's feed.xml, and an OOM kill already broke this once

choices.label: Copy the token once from athena's pass to ~/.sase on apollo; publishing survives gpg-agent restarts
Keep pass; Bryan unlocks apollo's gpg-agent by hand after each restart; bob's warning is the signal
